paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation:
Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, and tick labels at intervals of 100. Both plots also share a common y-axis labeled “Training Rewards” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The top plot illustrates the training rewards for the "Easy" training set. A teal line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" begins at approximately 0.0 at step 0, increases with a mostly steady trend to approximately 0.35 at step 500, with some fluctuations along the way. A red line representing “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” starts at approximately 0.0 at step 0, increases with a generally steady trend to approximately 0.4 at step 500, also exhibiting some fluctuations.

The bottom plot illustrates the training rewards for the "Hard" training set. A teal line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” starts at approximately 0.0 at step 0, rises to approximately 0.05 at step 50, then declines to approximately 0.0 by step 150, and remains around this level with variations until approximately 0.02 at step 500. A red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” begins at approximately 0.0 at step 0, and increases with a generally steady trend to approximately 0.2 at step 500, with fluctuations present throughout the plot.
